adjudication.rationale: The diff rewrites `Admin::GroupsController#create` and `#update` to accept top-level params (`name`, `visible`, `alias_level`) and changes behavior (e.g., `group.alias_level = params[:alias_level].to_i if ...`, `group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"`, `group.name = params[:name] if ... && !group.automatic`). In `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb`, new tests cover name stripping on create and ignoring renames for automatic groups, plus add/remove members endpoints, but there is no test for (a) renaming a *non-automatic* group, (b) alias_level assignment on update, (c) visible handling beyond the automatic-group case, or (d) the `render_json_error` paths when `group.save` fails in create/update/add_members/remove_member. These are specific, newly/reworked code paths with no corresponding assertions carried over from deleted tests.
